preliminaryClassification: Design Impact or runtime resource implementation issue; focused failure-origin review required
preliminaryOrigin: The approved 2.5-GiB blocking budget was derived from approximately 2.08-GB isolated Fun-ASR observations, but the exact persistent packaged process measured 3.678 GiB while successfully completing all 260 attempts. The current 64-GiB host has capacity, and the user explicitly prioritizes functionality and accepts this observation, but API/E2E cannot unilaterally change the approved blocking requirement.
stopPolicy: Fail closed under the current requirement; no threshold change, measurement omission, provider/model substitution, retry, English/QSet/projection, or release action.
